```yaml
name: Termux Tests

on:
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Weekly on Sunday at midnight UTC

jobs:
  termux-base:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Run Termux tests (Base Requirements)
        uses: addnab/docker-run-action@v3
        with:
          image: termux/termux-docker:latest
          options: --platform linux/arm64 -v ${{ github.workspace }}:/home/btcrecover -w /home/btcrecover
          run: |
            apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip
            pip3 install -r requirements.txt
            python3 run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer

  termux-full:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Run Termux tests (Full Requirements)
        uses: addnab/docker-run-action@v3
        with:
          image: termux/termux-docker:latest
          options: --platform linux/arm64 -v ${{ github.workspace }}:/home/btcrecover -w /home/btcrecover
          run: |
            apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip
            pip3 install -r requirements-full.txt
            python3 run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer
```
